outcome: clinical complications (hemorrhagic shock, rupture of pregnancy sac, hemoperitoneum)
cohort: The study included 146 ovarian pregnancy patients as cases, matched with 292 tubal pregnancy patients and 292 intrauterine pregnancy women as controls.
finding: Ovarian pregnancy patients experienced more severe clinical complications and required more emergency laparotomies, with ART and IUD use identified as potential risk factors for ovarian ectopic pregnancy.
